strings.name: Scarlett Johansson
strings.summary: Johansson entered theater and film as a child, moving through The Horse Whisperer and Ghost World to adult roles in Lost in Translation. Her career spans Her, Under the Skin and Marvel's Black Widow, alongside a Tony Award and two Oscar nominations. In 2025, Eleanor the Great marked her feature directorial debut and a broader creative role.

strings.timeline.t2.text: Eleanor the Great premiered at Cannes; she discussed aging, grief and the ethics of storytelling.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Two Oscar nominations
strings.timeline.t3.text: Received lead and supporting nominations for the 2019 films Marriage Story and Jojo Rabbit.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Stage award and Marvel debut
strings.timeline.t4.text: Won a Tony for A View from the Bridge and first played Black Widow in Iron Man 2.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Adult-role breakthrough
strings.timeline.t5.text: Appeared in Lost in Translation and Girl with a Pearl Earring, winning a BAFTA for the former.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Appeared in Ghost World
strings.timeline.t6.text: Portrayed youthful alienation in independent cinema, broadening early recognition.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Appeared in The Horse Whisperer
